notes: Manufacturer SKU 95-00498; sold under the "RAPTOR SDI" family name on ospreyvideo.com but the datasheet itself titles it "Osprey® 925." This is a half-height PCI Express Gen2 x4 capture/frame-grabber card (fits x4/x8/x16 slots), not a standalone rack or desktop unit, so rackUnits is omitted. It is entirely bus-powered via the PCIe edge connector (~5W draw, well under the slot budget) — there is no discrete power connector, so no power port is listed. Audio is embedded in the SDI signal (16 channels / 8 stereo pairs per BNC input); there is no separate analog/digital audio connector. Video connectors support SD/HD/3G-SDI (SMPTE-259/292/296/424/425, 3G Level A) — 3G is the highest tier, hence grade sdi-3g on both BNCs. A "Rugged" variant (extended -20 to 60°C range, conformal coating, 3-yr warranty) is available with identical I/O. Not to be confused with the sibling Raptor 927 model, which instead pairs 1x SDI with 1x HDMI input plus a Mini-XLR analog audio input.
